days.title: Family Mountain Adventures
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Silvretta Montafon
stops.detail: In addition to the best-known ski area of Silvretta Montafon, there are also Gargellen, Golm, Kristberg and Silvretta-Bielerhöhe.

stops.name: Golm
stops.detail: Skiing with children: the Silvretta Montafon ski area, the Golm ski area and skiing on the Kristberg in Silbertal are known for being especially family-friendly, with wide, easy-to-navigate slopes and ski schools.

stops.name: Gauertaler AlpkulTour
stops.detail: Family-friendly hikes: easy themed trails such as the Gauertaler AlpkulTour or Golmi’s Adventure World .
